worldcombat.skill.megahorn.summary: The user paws the ground, then drives its horn down a long, narrow line: only a thin horn line in front connects, so stepping aside or leaving during the charge makes it miss; on a hit it can either toss the target into the air or leave the horn planted and keep slowing it.
worldcombat.skill.megahorn.use.0: Trade a long charge for the heaviest single stab
worldcombat.skill.megahorn.use.1: Fling a target in front into the air, off its position
worldcombat.skill.megahorn.use.2: Plant a barb to slow a target for your team
worldcombat.skill.megahorn.description.0: Paw the ground and step in, then drive the horn down the aimed true-3D line, %2$s blocks long and %3$s blocks half-wide (aim freely up or down); the tip stops at the real contact point or the wall face, dealing about %1$s contact damage to the first target on the line. The body advance is a real sweep of up to %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.megahorn.rip.on: Flung horn: the second beat adds a rip hit (power %1$s) and tosses a target still on the horn line about %2$s blocks along the horn and upward (launch speed %3$s blocks/tick); a target that stepped away or put a wall between is released, so this beat misses, and displacement only follows a landed second hit.
worldcombat.skill.megahorn.rip.off: Planted horn: a barb stays in the wound, slowing the target's movement by %2$s level(s) for %1$s; the barb fades with that slow.
worldcombat.skill.megahorn.timing: Range %1$s blocks; charge %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.megahorn.growth.0: From level %1$s the pierce power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.megahorn.growth.1: From level %1$s the pierce power rises to %2$s and the toss to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.megahorn.preference.ri: On (flung horn): the second beat adds rip damage and tosses the target up and back, at the cost of x0.9 pierce power, +3 charge and +6 cooldown, driving the target off its position. Off (planted horn): x1.05 pierce power and a barb left in the wound slows the target by 1 for dozens of ticks, at the cost of x0.94 reach, a narrower horn line and +3 recovery, holding the ground.
